Study the following bar graph that shows the number of students enrolled for different courses in institutes A and B during 5 years, and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/487570190d3ea64ca165ae7867c66a4002ebe1ee73b44268554d2a5fb58d283e.png] 

The average number of students (per year) enrolled in A during 2015, 2016 and 2018 is what percentage less than the number of students enrolled in B during 2015 (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of students enrolled in institute A in year 2015 = 280 

Number of students enrolled in institute A in year 2016 = 300

Number of students enrolled in institute A in year 2018 = 260 

Number of students enrolled in institute B in year 2015 = 360 

**Formula used:**

Average number of students for particular years = Sum of the students/No of years 

**Calculation:**

Average number of students in A during 2015, 2016 & 2018 = (280 + 300 + 260)/3

⇒ 840/3 = 280

Difference between the number of students enrolled in B during 2015 and average number of students in A during 2015, 2016 & 2018 = 360 - 280 

⇒ 80 

∴ The required percentage = 80/360 × 100 

**⇒ 22.2%**

questions.question:
The following bar graph shows the total number of students who appeared in an exam from five different schools.

Approximately how much percent of total students who appeared in the exam are failed?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ef58479b0393e0eb3581295a7378f0a54cef1d944084ae2d07a502c614bf94d.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number of students appeared in exam from school A = 600

The number of students appeared in exam from school B = 720

The number of students appeared in exam from school C = 428

The number of students appeared in exam from school D = 920

The number of students appeared in exam from school E = 1100

**Concept:**

X\%={Xover100}

**Calculation:​**

According to the question

The failed students in school A = 600 - 320 = 280

The failed students in school B = 720 - 400 = 320

The failed students in school C = 428 - 312 = 116

The failed students in school D = 920 - 480 = 440

The failed students in school E = 1100 - 640 = 460

The sum of all appeared students in schools = 600 + 720 + 428 + 920 + 1100 = 3768

The sum of all failed students in schools = 280 + 320 + 116 + 440 + 460 = 1616

The required percentage = {1616over3768}times 100=42.88\%

∴ The required result will be **approximately**** **44%.

The given bar graph shows the sum invested by a different persons, A, B, C and D, in a bank on simple interest. Study the graph and answer the question given below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6fece2c86e169fda6819e68cc08bb1d9260b21e6a82f25cfe2ab266de789667.png] 

If the amount received by B after 5 years at rate of interest R% p.a. is equal to the amount received by D after 3{1over2} years at the same rate of interest p.a., then the value of R is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal of B = Rs. 18,000

Principal of D = Rs. 20,000

Time of B = 5 years

Time of D = 3{1over2} = 7/2 years

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

A = P + SI

**Calculation:**

According to the question

P + (P × R × T)/100 = P + (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 18,000 + (18,000 × R × 5)/100 = 20,000 + (20,000 × R × 7)/(2 × 100)

⇒ 18,000 + 900R = 20,000 + 700R

⇒ (900R – 700R) = (20,000 – 18,000)

⇒ 200R = 2000

⇒ R = (2000/200)

⇒ R = 10%

**∴ The required rate is 10% **

What was the percentage (in%) drop in the production of food grains from 1991 to 1992?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Bar graph showing the production of food grains by a State over the years (in 1000 tons).

Production in 1991 = 60 (thousand tons)

Production in 1992 = 45 (thousand tons)

**Calculations:**

Drop in production from 1991 to 1992 = Production in 1991 - Production in 1992

Drop = 60 - 45 = 15 (thousand tons)

Percentage drop = (Drop in production / Production in the initial year) × 100

Percentage drop = (15 / 60) × 100

Percentage drop = (1 / 4) × 100

Percentage drop = 25%

**∴ The percentage drop in the production of food grains from 1991 to 1992 was 25%.**
